The '''Ebruchi''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of a [[Ebruchi]] [[Unidentified Ebruchi clan|nomadic clan]] which served as the [[Species/Legends|species]] home. Composed of [[Ebruchi light freighter]]s, [[Ebruchi starfighter|starfighters]], and Ebruchi [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], the fleet was composed of several armadas, which themselves are formed by several flotillas.<ref name="TUR" />
